subject: Downtime compensation request — Oct 29 incident (Orchid Labs)
messages:
From: Jamie Ramos <jamie.ramos@orchidlabs.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Service disruption on Oct 29 - request for compensation

Hi Mina —

We experienced a significant outage on Oct 29 that affected our production inference in us-east-1. Our on-call timeline shows degraded responses starting ~01:15 UTC and full restoration at ~04:45 UTC (roughly 3.5 hours of impact). This affected query traffic for our NightBatch job and caused timeouts for live customers.

Per section 5.2 of our contract (SLA & credits), Orchid Labs is requesting a formal eligibility determination and a calculation of any service credit due for the Oct billing period. For reference, our October invoice number is INV-ORCH-2026-10.

I've attached a short timeline and our collected support logs. We'd like an expedited determination because we are mid-renewal and our finance team needs the credit applied in the November invoice cycle if eligible.

Attachments: orchid_incident_timeline_20261102.pdf, orchid_support_logs_20261029.zip

Thanks,
Jamie Ramos
Head of Platform Engineering
Orchid Labs
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Ramos <jamie.ramos@orchidlabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service disruption on Oct 29 - request for compensation

Hi Jamie —

Thanks for sending the timeline and logs. I'm very sorry Orchid saw that disruption. We've already opened an internal incident (IR-2026-10-29-ORCHID) and our postmortem is in progress — I'll link it below.

Next steps from our side:
- Rishi (Ops) will validate the outage window and impacted capacity (we'll confirm whether prefix/KV cache or routing fallbacks caused the extended duration).
- Laura (Billing) will look up INV-ORCH-2026-10 and confirm the billing period to compute the credit.
- I will produce an eligibility determination and a proposed credit amount within 48 hours. If you can confirm whether you want the credit applied to the November invoice or issued as a standalone refund, please let me know — I can route either way.

Can you also confirm whether any production traffic was rerouted to another region (us-west-2) during the window — that helps with impact weighting.

I'm cc'ing Laura and Rishi to pick this up.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Service disruption on Oct 29 - request for compensation

Jamie —

Thanks for confirming the routing and for the attachments. Rishi and I completed validation against our telemetry and the incident timeline you provided. Below is our determination and the proposed credit calculation.

Summary of validation:
- Confirmed impact window: 2026-10-29 01:14:30 UTC to 2026-10-29 04:45:10 UTC (~3 hours 30 minutes).
- Impacted scope: production inference cluster in us-east-1 (no cross-region failover observed).
- Root cause (preview): a faulty autoscaler reconciliation combined with a kernel-level scheduler delay during a rolling update; full postmortem attached (redwood_postmortem_ir-2026-10-29.pdf).

SLA / Credit policy applied (contract Sxn 5.2):
Redwood uses the contract tiered credit schedule:
- <60 minutes impact in a billing cycle: 10% credit for the affected service month
- 60–180 minutes: 25% credit
- >180 minutes: 50% credit (cap)

Calculation for Orchid Labs (October billing month):
- Measured impact: ~210 minutes (>180 minutes) -> qualifies for the >180 minutes bucket
- Monthly invoice (Oct): USD 42,500 (per INV-ORCH-2026-10)
- Proposed service credit = 50% of the monthly fee = USD 21,250

Proposed next steps:
1) Please confirm that you would like the USD 21,250 applied to INV-ORCH-2026-11 (as requested) — we will then issue an invoice credit memo and update HubSpot.
2) Alternatively, if you prefer a bank refund, Laura will provide the paperwork and timeline (standard processing: 7–10 business days after approval).
3) We will include the attached postmortem and a short remediation plan in the credit memo for your records.

Rishi, Laura: please advise if anything on your side changes the proposed credit or the processing path.

Jamie, I'm really sorry for the customer impact. If you'd like, I can set up a brief remediation walkthrough with our SREs (30 minutes) next week to go over the fixes and the timeline to prevent recurrence.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_postmortem_ir-2026-10-29.pdf
